text:
Maya (Sales): passing Seastar Analytics to CS - 200-seat pilot, US/EU, wants private VPC deploy + SAML SSO + per-route SLAs (p50 <120ms for query endpoints), token-level billing export, and daily audit logs. Pilot go-live target 2025-10-06. They plan a long-running batch of embeddings (5M vectors) and occasional bulk exports. Please own onboarding and surface infra/compliance blockers.

Rico (CS): Thanks Maya. Quick Qs: who is their infra contact? expected pilot concurrency? any early renewal signals?

Maya (Sales): Contact is Lena (Seastar infra). Pilot concurrency ~60 concurrent users, ramp to ~400 over 90 days. Renewal interest: asked about a 12-month commit and early renew credits. They also asked about a runbook for SOC2 auditors.

Rico (CS): Noted. Top risks: multi-region private deploy complexity, per-route SLA support, audit log retention/PII, bulk embedding throughput. Tentative owners: Rico (onboarding lead), June (support/runbook), Arun (eng infra), Maya (sales sponsor). I'll open the support ticket and schedule kickoff.

June (Support): Creating ticket now and will add a runbook stub. Need: exact billing export format (CSV/JSON), whether audit logs include request bodies, and preferred retention window. Also flagging dedicated GPU lead time for EU region may be 10 business days.

audit-bot: Support ticket SUP-8133 created "Seastar private deploy + SLAs + embeddings" assigned to June.

Arun (Eng): Two infra notes: 1) per-route SLA requires route-level routing and autoscale config; may not be fully supported in private VPC by default. 2) Model choice + seq length will change GPU sizing drastically. If they want 70B dense for gen and embeddings concurrently we need separate pools or mixed workload scheduling. Please confirm model families.

Rico (CS): Action items: 1) Kickoff + enablement (owner: Rico) 2) Support ticket + runbook (owner: June -> SUP-8133) 3) Confirm model choices & max seq with customer (owner: Maya -> Lena) 4) Billing export spec + sample (owner: Rico + Billing Ops) 5) SLA feasibility and routing design (owner: Arun) 6) Provision capacity after model confirmed (owner: Arun) 7) SOC2 audit checklist draft (owner: Rico) 8) Post-pilot feedback survey + product tag (owner: Rico).

Maya (Sales): I'll ask Lena for model family, sequence length, audit log detail (bodies vs metadata), and preferred billing file format today. Also will surface renewal interest/ask re: early-renew credits.

June (Support): Runbook snippet in SUP-8133: ```- Validate SAML metadata exchange - VPC peering & route propagation check - Define audit log schema & retention - Ingest throttling plan for 5M vectors - Per-route SLA smoke tests (p50/p95) - Escalation: ping @Arun for infra quota```

Arun (Eng): I'll prototype a routing policy doc and note limitations for private VPC. If they insist on per-route SLA we may recommend a small hosted-edge for SLA-critical routes + private model pool for batch work. Posting draft in SUP-8133 by EOD.

Rico (CS): Scheduling kickoff: 2025-09-18 14:00 PT (Lena + Maya + June + Arun). Invite sent. Please review enablement slides before call: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/seastar (internal).

Maya (Sales): FYI Lena hinted they want an onboarding checklist to send to infra. Rico can you draft a 1-page infra checklist and a 1-page SSO checklist?

Rico (CS): Yep will post both before EOD tomorrow. Also adding a "renewal-watch" tag in SFDC and setting touches at 180/120/60/30 days.

June (Support): After kickoff I'll expand the runbook into an internal doc and add a testing checklist: small ingest -> SAML login -> audit log verification -> per-route SLA perf smoke.

Arun (Eng): I'll add model/quantization tradeoff notes to SUP-8133 and recommend default profiles for cost vs latency. If they plan concurrent embed + gen, we need either separate pools or GPU multiplexing config; will propose options.

Maya (Sales): Great. Anything else? :thumbsup:

Rico (CS): One more ask  Lena wants sample billing export and a short note we can hand to finance. I'll coordinate with Billing Ops and post the sample CSV in SUP-8133. Closing this handoff thread here; keep updates in SUP-8133 and the onboarding calendar.
